rules.statement: An heir cannot bring an action to recover property which belonged to the estate of a deceased intestate without taking out administration, unless the estate is a small one as defined by law.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now it seems to me, as I said before, that she has misconceived her rights; that she was not competent to bring this action to recover property which belonged to the estate of her mother Anso, either under the old law or the new law, whether the case falls to be decided under the Code or under the law as it existed before the passing of the Code."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: By section 547 of the Civil Procedure Code of 1889, no estate which amounted to the sum of Rs. 1,000 was to be considered small, and in every case where the estate amounted to or exceeded in value Rs. 1,000 administration should be taken.
